desc: the frame doubled over a copy of itself, lifted and solarised

params.name: size
params.help: size of the second copy — a small inset in a streaked border up to a big magnified overlay

params.name: flip
params.help: which way the copy faces, in quarters: straight, mirrored, upside down, both

params.name: blend
params.help: how much of the copy comes through — a ghost at the bottom, a hard double at the top

params.name: lift
params.help: dark and contrasty below halfway, brightened above it, then the highlights invert
